newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers fall, low demand.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers fall, low demand.

text.p: Rail and truck soymeal offers fell further Wednesday as the market's current high prices continued to discourage end-user buying, soymeal brokers said.
On Tuesday, March and May soymeal contracts on the CBOT soared to fresh contract highs, and May climbed to a 10-month high.
As of 1034 CST Wednesday, March soymeal was down $2.60 per ton at $258.00, but dealers reported little activity on the break.
"I'm not going to fight the (price) trend, so I'm trying to talk people into taking coverage," said one Indiana dealer.
"But we're just seeing a little routine pricing," he said.
Another dealer in the Midwest truck market said end-users in his area were only taking weekly or partial week coverage as they wait and hope for relief from high soymeal prices.
